system.tactics: “I can't fix it… I'm sorry.” Mortimer's voice, in the wrong mouth.
system.tagline: An elderly man's broken corpse held aloft by oily black flesh, bulging with cloudy eyes and gibbering mouths.

abilities.name: HORROR
abilities.description: While unwarded, your tests are -1M easier and tests targeting you are +1M harder.

abilities.name: DARK ARMOR
abilities.description: Whenever you end your turn in an unwarded zone, heal +1 BODY. Whenever you start your turn in a warded zone, your armor does not refill.

abilities.name: SLIPPERY QUICK
abilities.description: You move freely through barricades and obstacles, and can carry creatures you are grappling without penalty.

actions.name: FALSE-SONG
actions.description: Invigorate yourself. Each enemy within 3 range that hears your song must succeed a WILL + SURVIVAL test or take 1 WILL damage and become dazed.

actions.name: BITE
actions.boons: Spend 1 boon to grapple the target in one of your many mouths.

actions.name: DEVOUR
actions.description: Bite a creature you are grappling. Deals 2 piercing BODY damage and heals Not-Papa for 1 BODY.
